faqs.question: Do you customize the theme or use a template?
faqs.answer: We build a custom, on-brand theme (or deeply customize a premium one) so your store stands out and loads fast — no cookie-cutter look.

faqs.question: Can you migrate our existing Shopify store?
faqs.answer: Yes — we redesign and re-platform existing stores while preserving products, orders, and SEO.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
